title: Hardship Relief Applied to the Out-of-Network Visit Share
content:
For an Out-of-Network Referral (Referrals & Prior Authorizations), hardship relief of the out-of-network visit share follows the hardship approval on the patient's Patient Financial Account on the handling date:

- where the approval runs through the handling date or later and its percentage is 50 or more, the copay and the deductible part are added and that sum is reduced by the approved percentage;
- where the approval runs through the handling date or later and its percentage is above zero but below 50, only the deductible part is reduced by the approved percentage and the copay is kept whole;
- otherwise nothing is reduced, and the copay and the deductible part are added as they stand.

Each reduced figure is rounded half up to the cent. Reducing an amount by the approved percentage means multiplying it by one hundred less that percentage and dividing by 100.

## Worked memo (hypothetical copay of 30.00 and deductible part of 50.00; handling date 2026-09-10)

| Hardship approval on the account | Relieved copay and deductible part |
|---|---|
| 75 percent, through 2026-12-31 | the sum 80.00 reduced by 75 percent: 20.00 |
| 50 percent, through 2026-09-10 | the sum 80.00 reduced by 50 percent: 40.00 |
| 40 percent, through 2026-12-31 | copay 30.00 whole plus 50.00 reduced by 40 percent (30.00): 60.00 |
| 75 percent, through 2026-09-09 | ended before the handling date — nothing reduced: 80.00 |
| none | nothing reduced: 80.00 |

An approval that runs through the handling date itself counts as running through it.
